recommended_public_disposition: Fold into the next compact Noether German current-control/source-audit rebalance. Do not upload as loose front-facing reader files while the Noether record is at the Zenodo file ceiling.
global_caveat: These are German current-control/source-patch/source-audit support packages, not a critical edition, not whole-corpus certification, not multilingual synchronization, and not a claim that Noether is complete. Source witnesses are mixed GDZ 400 and 600 ppi; enlarged crops and derived renders are readability witnesses, not native 1000 dpi source scans.

artifacts.scope: Web R272 current base derived from Web R271, promoting only source-certain Paper 19 and Paper 20 line-level repairs from the local R271CSI closure bridge.
artifacts.result: Contains cum_de_R272.tex/PDF, changed output slices, source pages for changed P19/P20 printed pages, ledgers, renders, and input provenance. It promotes 24 source-certain P19/P20 repairs and explicitly rejects wholesale import of the older local cumulative.

artifacts.kind: German current-control rebase plus no-patch P14 visual audit
artifacts.scope: Starts from the R272 P19/P20 current base, reapplies four already source-verified LocalCodex P12/P15 repairs that R272 did not contain, and visually audits Paper 14 printed pp.182-203 against GDZ 600 ppi witnesses.
artifacts.result: Reapplies P12 p41 formula (10), P15 p149 formula (7), P15 p151 S_0^(l), and P15 p155 substitution sentence. P14 receives no source-certain TeX patch in this pass; all pp.182-203 are marked no-patch under native600 best-staged source.

quality_caveat: R272 is a useful current-base candidate and repair carrier, but it does not close Noether. The P14 audit is full visual coverage over pp.182-203 under best-staged native600 evidence, below the preferred native650+ threshold, and is therefore a strong no-patch/support pass rather than strict paper certification.
